Name: Eggtosis - Craft Eggs from Large Egg
Author: Imbion
Description:
Large egg. Now two eggs. How? Don't worry about it.

[u][b]What it does:[/b][/u]
Adds a configurable crafting recipe that unlocks at Farming level 4, which allows you to craft large eggs into two regular eggs. For both colours.

[b][u]Config Options:[/u][/b]
- Recipe Variants:
﻿- [b]Divide: [/b]Convert one large egg into two eggs.
﻿- [b]Stone: [/b]Conversion recipe also costs two stone. (Default)
﻿- [b]Hardwood: [/b]Conversion recipe also costs one hardwood.
﻿- [b]Disabled:[/b] Add no crafting recipe.

Manifest.Name: Eggtosis
Manifest.Description: Adds configurable crafting recipies to divide large egg into regular eggs.
Manifest.Author: Imbion
